plot 0..6, 0..max(max(days last 7 days, sum(entry.mins on it)), 1) axes gridlines
  poly stroke accent thick 2
    each days last 7 days
      pt index, sum(entry.mins on it)
  each days last 7 days
    tick index, dayname(it)
form entry, "Add work"

request: For a busy housewife with a dog to walk, it shows today's minutes against a daily goal of 60, quick buttons for 15, 30 and 45, and a bar chart of the last week.
program:
app "Dog walks" paw ocean
table stroll mins num 5..180 unit "min"
setting goal num = 60 "Daily goal (min)"
goal sum(stroll.mins today), goal, "today", "min"
quick stroll, mins, [15, 30, 45]
form stroll
daybars last 7 days, sum(stroll.mins on it)
list stroll

request: gratitude daily 3 things reminder pls
program:
app "Gratitude" heart plum
table thanks note text
remind "What are you thankful for today?" at 8:00, 21:30
count(thanks today) "of 3 things today" head
form thanks, "I am thankful for"
streak(thanks) "day streak" faint
list thanks by day

request: For a tailor who drives to a job each morning, open car tasks show by priority with the highest first, a tick box for each, a count at the top and a Done list underneath for finished ones.
program:
app "Car checklist" car plum
table car_task title text, done bool, priority pick Low|Normal|High = Normal
count(car_task where done = no) "open" head
each car_task where done = no sort priority desc as t
  row card gap 2 tap edit t swipe remove t
    toggle t.done
    t.title grow
form car_task
"Done" faint
list car_task where done = yes

request: A progress bar for calories today against a goal of 2000, plus quick buttons for 100, 250 and 500 kcal, an average entry from the last 30 days, and a 7 day chart.
program:
app "Calories" food slate
table bite kcal num 10..3000 unit "kcal"
setting goal num = 2000 "Daily goal (kcal)"
stat streak(bite), "day streak"
goal sum(bite.kcal today), goal, "today"
stat round(avg(bite.kcal last 30 days)), "average entry, last 30 days"
quick bite, kcal, [100, 250, 500]
form bite
daybars last 7 days, sum(bite.kcal on it)
list bite by day

request: Each exercise needs sets from 1 to 20 starting at 3, reps and kg, and I want to see how many exercises I did today. I'm a bit careful about what I write down, so an easy list by day helps.
program:
app "My Gym log" dumbbell ink
table sets exercise text, sets num 1..20 = 3, reps num 1.., kg num 0.. = 0
count(sets today) "exercises today" head
form sets
list sets by day

request: A plus one rep button builds the current set on screen, Save set logs it and resets the count, and a total for today sits at the top with a Clear button for mistakes.
program:
app "Push ups" dumbbell ink
table setr reps num 1..500
state cur num = 0
cur big
button "+1 rep" tap set cur = cur + 1
row gap 1
  button "Save set" tap add setr reps = cur then set cur = 0
  button "Clear" tap set cur = 0
"Total today" sum(setr.reps today) bold
each setr today sort at desc as r
  row card tap edit r swipe remove r
    "Set of" r.reps

request: mood tap 1 to 5 and see the month
program:
app "Mood" smile plum
table mood score num 1..5
"How do you feel?" head
row gap 1
  each 1..5
    button it grow tap add mood score = it
"Last 4 weeks" faint
grid 7 gap 1
  each days last 28 days
    box height 26 radius 6 fill if(count(mood on it) = 0, soft, hue(avg(mood.score on it) * 30))
"Average this month" round(avg(mood.score month) * 10) / 10 "of 5" faint

request: sleep befor 11 streak counter
program:
app "Sleep before 11" bed ink
table early
setting target num = 5
let n = count(early today)
draw width 240 tap add early
  circle 44 stroke soft thick 8
  arc 44, 0, 360 * clamp(n / target, 0, 1) stroke accent thick 8
  label 50, 46, n big
  label 50, 64, "of" target faint
when n = target notify "Target reached"

request: Stars today sits in big type, with a morning checklist of tick boxes and a form to add tasks. A weekly chart shows the last seven days, plus a 20 minute bedtime timer.
program:
app "My Kids Routine" star mint
table task name text
table done task ref task
table star why text?
let stars = count(done today)
"Stars today" stars big
"Morning checklist" head
each task
  row card
    it.name grow
    toggle it.done
form task, "Add morning task"
"Weekly star chart" head
daybars last 7 days, count(done on it)
timer 20m, "Bedtime timer", notify "Time for bed"

request: A big day streak and a big weekly total at the top. A form adds a donation from 10 up to a million. A list by day lets me tap to edit or swipe away.
program:
app "Charity" gift slate
table donation amount money 10..1000000
stat streak(donation), "day streak"
stat sum(donation.amount week), "this week"
form donation
list donation by day

request: A big number for floors climbed this week, quick buttons for 5, 10 and 20 floors, and a bar chart of the last seven days with a list and a reminder every two hours.
program:
app "Stairs" run plum
table climb floors num 1..100 unit "floors", note text?

remind "Time to log stairs I climb" every 2h from 9:00 to 21:00
